title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - PartyPrivacyAgreement
description: A specific type of agreement that formalizes the privacy profiles requested for a party (TM Forum TMF644 Privacy 5.0.0, OpenAPI component PartyPrivacyAgreement; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:PartyPrivacyAgreement:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PartyPrivacyAgreement'

agreementSpecification.description: Relationship. An AgreementSpecification represents a template of an agreement that can be used when establishing partnerships. In TMF this is a AgreementSpecificationRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced AgreementSpecification entity (urn:ngsi-ld:AgreementSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.
